title: iPhone Ultra is coming, but it might not have these key features
summary: The iPhone Ultra will reportedly have two cameras, including a Main camera and an Ultra Wide camera. The Main and Ultra Wide cameras on the iPhone Ultra are both expected to be 48MP, similar to the current base model iPhone 17.
